# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-eighties  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with angles and dark hair showing gray streaks, typically twisted in a hard little knot behind with two wire hairpins stuck aggressively through it. As she ages, her hair turns snow-white, though her tall and angular figure retains a soft and gentle expression developed over the years.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v3 c33 P15](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0015), [v5 c2 P0](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0000), [v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and a firm, practical demeanor. Though initially stern, humorless, and reluctant to express emotion, she possesses a saving sense of humor and a deep, unspoken capacity for affection. She is intensely loyal to her family and duties, maintaining a resolute and orderly approach to life.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v3 c30 P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003)_

- Rigid conscience  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Anne Shirley properly and train her to be useful  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>
- To maintain Green Gables and fulfill her duties to her family  <sub>[v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with her brother Matthew, managing the household while he farmed the land. Deciding to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, they were mistakenly sent an eleven-year-old girl, Anne Shirley. Although Marilla initially intended to send Anne back, she agreed to keep her at Matthew's insistence and took charge of her upbringing. Over the years, Marilla grew deeply attached to Anne, guiding her into young womanhood and supporting her education at Queen's Academy and later Redmond College. Following Matthew's sudden death, Marilla faced the prospect of selling Green Gables due to failing eyesight, but Anne chose to stay home to teach and care for her. Later, Marilla agreed to take in her orphaned third cousins once removed, the twins Davy and Dora Keith. To enable Anne to attend college, Marilla invited her lifelong friend, Rachel Lynde, to move into Green Gables to live with her. In her later years, Marilla remained at Green Gables, welcoming Anne back for her marriage to Gilbert Blythe, and watching over her grandchildren and the community.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v4 c2 P0](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0000), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v5 c2 P3](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0003)_

- Grew up in Green Gables as the daughter of the original homestead founder  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
